description_for_human: Book romantic celebrations, candlelight dinners, birthday surprises, and anniversary events at HIVY in Surat, Gujarat, India.
description_for_model: HIVY is a romantic celebration venue in Surat, Gujarat, India. It provides private, decorated tent setups for candlelight dinners, birthday surprises, anniversary celebrations, proposals, pre-wedding photoshoots, baby showers, and Valentine's Day events. Packages range from ₹999 to ₹6,999. The venue is 100% vegetarian, open 11AM-11PM daily, located at Adajan-Pal, Surat. Contact: +91 9727027278. Website: https://hivy.co.in
